title: مدخل إلى GCSE العربية (1AA0)
obj: أعرف خريطة امتحان GCSE العربية: أوراق القراءة والكتابة، والدرجات، ولغة الإجابة، والجداول. Know the exam map.
sc: أعرف أوراق الامتحان ودرجاتها ولغة الإجابة.

where.split: Paper 3H: 50 marks؛ Paper 4H: 60 marks (Q1 20 + Q2 28 + Q3 12)

skill: A: answers in English (28)؛ B: in Arabic (15)؛ C: translation into English (7).

example.title: خريطة الامتحان
text: أجب عن الأسئلة، ثم اقرأ الشرح.

qs.q: What are the writing tasks in Paper 4 (Higher)? ما مهام الورقة 4؟

full.a: Q1 informal 80–90 words (20)؛ Q2 formal 130–150 words (28)؛ Q3 translation into Arabic (12).

part.note: Q1 is a short informal text.

qs.q: In Paper 3 (Reading), which language do you answer in? بأيّ لغة تجيب؟

full.a: Section A in English؛ Section B in Arabic؛ Section C translation into English.

part.note: Section A answers are in English.

qs.q: How many bullet points must you cover in Q1 and Q2?

full.a: All four bullet points — النقاط الأربع كلها.

part.note: Missing a bullet limits the band.

qs.q: Which two grids mark Q1 and Q2?
How is the translation into English (Paper 3, Q10) marked?

full.a: In bands for the whole passage (0–7).

sort: Paper 3 Section A: answers in English
Paper 3 Section A: answers in French

para.src: What should you do at the end of the writing paper?
para.why: Examiners' report 2025: leave time at the end to review.
Q3 = translation from English into Arabic (12 marks).

para.src: Why did some answers to Q2(a) 2025 lose marks?
o: Wrote about sport and healthy lifestyle in general, not sport in school

exam.title: اختبر معرفتك بالامتحان
text: اختر الإجابة الصحيحة. تُصحَّح إجاباتك آليًّا.

qs.q: Q2 in Paper 4H must be written in:
Which season word did many students confuse in 2025?
Which is NOT allowed in your Arabic writing?

mistakes: Missing a bullet point limits the band.
